package.name: astribot_s1_mapping
package.description: Cartographer-style submap-based global occupancy grid for navigation. Subscribes to voxel_slam's own keyframe interface (astribot_slam_msgs): each keyframe's local-frame cloud is ray-cast into its own frozen local submap grid exactly once, and every keyframe's pose (as corrected by voxel_slam's own BTC loop closure / GTSAM pose-graph optimization / HBA global BA) is used to place that submap in the world when compositing the published map — so loop-closure corrections move whole submaps rigidly, without needing to re-insert their points. Also bridges the gap while voxel_slam isn't producing new keyframes (it only does so once the robot has moved far enough — standing still stops them entirely): a dedicated "stall submap" ray-casts voxel_slam's raw /map_scan_filtered against its continuous TF until a real keyframe resumes, so the published map keeps reflecting nearby dynamic obstacles even while stationary. Entirely downstream of voxel_slam — no further changes to that package are needed for this node to exist.
